Name: Em's Farm Animals (collection bundle)
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A complete bundle of all Em's farm animals
Optionally change the feathers, duck egg, wool, cloth and mayo jars
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative Textures
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/KvgdkHv6/Duck-Config.png[/img]

There are three egg colours: [color=#e69138]brown[/color], [color=#e69138]blue[/color] and [color=#e69138]black[/color]
[color=#efefef]There are twelve duck feathers based on each duck type[/color]
[color=#efefef]This also applies to the wool and cloth for sheep and rabbits[/color]
Chicken, duck and dino mayo jars are included by default

The dinosaurs have three main config options
Incubation time: 2500 (1 day), 7500 (3 days), 12500 (5 days), 18000 (7 days)
Egg option: ﻿eight options to change the look of the dinosaur egg
Type: changes the name of dino's and their produce from "[color=#e69138]dino[/color]" to "[color=#e69138]dragon[/color]"
These configs are all ﻿optional. If you leave them on default, nothing changes from vanilla

The ostrich has three options for the shop icon
See the reference images for each one

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Farm Animals CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When hatching or buying an animal from Marnie, the type gets randomised and can be any of the included options
If you rather choose which type you buy, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar
[/url]
Alternatively, you can choose ﻿"Em's Farm Animals CP Config"
This allows you to choose [u]one[/u] of each animal type for your farm with a [i]config.json[/i]
Brown/white cows and chickens can both be set separately

To change the default into a different type:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Farm Animal mod folder
Replace the name between the "[color=#e69138]brackets[/color]" with the name of the type you like
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

For more info on each animal, take a look at their own page
Coop Animals [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35042]Em's Chickens[/url] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33762]Em's Rabbit[/url] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33766]Em's Ducks[/url] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36316]Em's Dinos[/url]
Barn Animals [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34915]Em's Goats[/url] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34698]﻿Em's Pigs[/url] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34512]Em's Sheep[/url] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34291]Em's Cows[/url] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35722]Em's Ostriches[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

[i]Update 1.1 Solved missing BlueRoan Cow and Silkie Chicken option
Update 1.2 Animal produce recolours are now optional and can be disabled
Update 1.3 CP now allows multiple types. Compatible with livestock bazaar. All previously updated animals included[/i]
[i]Update 1.4 CP included patch for the animals from the Stardew Valley Fair on the 16th of Fall. Wool and cloth are included[/i]
